parameters.name: ActionPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the execution plan.

parameters.name: DesiredCapacity
parameters.description: The expected scale of resources for the execution plan. If the ResourceType parameter is set to VcpuCapacity, the execution plan is expected to have 10000 vCPUs.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Whether to enable the execution plan. Valid values:

*   true: enables the execution plan.

*   false: The execution plan is disabled.

    **

    **Note:** After an execution plan is disabled, the created Instant jobs are not automatically managed by the execution plan.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpcinstant update-action-plan --action-plan-id ap-hz036ubmx2qmw93k0000 --desired-capacity 1000.0 --enabled true --interval-minutes 60 --region cn-hangzhou
